name: Gaussian Allocation Policy
definition: A reinforcement learning policy πψ that maps anchor tokens {an} and a target budget B to a discrete allocation k = {kn} where kn is the number of Gaussians for anchor n, such that Σkn = B.
summary: Gaussian Allocation Policy is a reinforcement learning method that optimizes 3D Gaussian distribution among anchor tokens to maximize rendering fidelity, differing from heuristics by learning complex geometric dependencies via discrete optimization.
